args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. 1 flagged, 7 cleared.
Flagged: r03 (summary_outlier). Its largest flank difference is -11.7 %/h. The batch median is -8.1 %/h, so this one is about 44% larger. Its peak position and flank-difference position match the batch, so it is the flank difference that changes the profile's shape, not a faster or slower root. All three checks passed. The run kept one remedy: frames registered on tissue starting 400 px from the tip. If 400 px falls inside the growth zone, the registration would remove real motion, which could explain the difference.
Cleared: r01, r02, r04, r05, r06, r07, r08. All checks pass and none kept a remedy or rolled back. Their largest |z| values (2.1 to 2.6) come from a batch MAD of 0 or nearly 0. The actual differences are only about 21 µm in position and 0.07 %/h or less in REGR peak.
Common factor: only one run is flagged. Its different flank difference (lateral strain-rate/curvature-rate profile) came with frame registration from 400 px from the tip, the only remedy kept in the batch.
